name: ScratchCards
author: Elvin
short: Weighted multi-prize scratch card game integrated with Red's bank
description: ScratchCards: buy configurable scratch cards, win weighted prizes deposited to Red's bank. Includes an admin UI to create/edit cards and prizes via buttons and modals.
install_msg: ScratchCards loaded. Use [p]scratch admin panel to create cards. Requires Red's bank to be enabled.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-guild configuration and card/prize data. It does not store personal data beyond user IDs used by Red for normal bot operations. No external services are used.
